notes.title: VR Golf Online Service Closing Announcement
notes.content:
First of all, thank you very much indeed for playing and loving VR Golf Online.

But we feel extremely sorry to notice that the VR Golf Online service will be closed.

We concluded that our game environment cannot provide adequate service,
so we decided closing of all VR Golf Online service very sadly, including single mode.

Thanks to every user who played VR Golf Online,
and we announce service closing schedule.

■ VR Golf Online service closing schedule
 - June 1, 2019 11:00(KST)
 
Once again, Thank you for playing VR Golf Online, it is greatly appreciated.

notes.title: Update Patchnote on 10th May
notes.content:
New & Updated Features:
- Mail Box
New 'Mail Box' feature is now available. You may win some item(s) or currency through mail box.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/bd3ee623d597b67f48229d485cdfcf0bb3a36085.jpg

- Rebalancing shot power
We have rebalanced the power value for each difficulty. You may feel more real like swing.

notes.title: Update Patchnote on 8th August
notes.content:
New & Updated Features:
- Left-handed mode
New 'Left-handed' Mode is now available. You may select the option from the Lobby.http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/f564bccfd8fd7ce8f091e705ad1b1af1e93bc86e.png

You may put down the right-handed controller after the setting.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/0def81df614b0ba18dcf21ac20700e20cbea83d7.png

notes.title: Update Patchnote on 22nd June
notes.content:
New & Updated Features:
- New Map "Wonder Valley"
New 18 holes are now available to play.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/6edf189b497dd48ddaf6abe63693391c61b18479.png

- Gold & Ruby
2 new currencies have been added. Gold can be earn from all modes(Single, AI, and Match). On the other hand, Ruby can be earned from the Match only.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/ebe3f61f16a867ea670a2644d90c33854316960c.png

- In Game Store Open
You may now purchase items with the new in game currency. Items are: 4 Club bags, 4 Golf Clubs, 4 Golf Balls, 4 Energy Drinks.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/95d6829f9d9598e64505d14f0e4ea8e27ac9a1e3.png
- Club bags: Permenant items
- Golf clubs: Durable items. 1 swing = 1 point deduction
- Golf ball: Maximum 10 ball. You will lose the ball when it goes to the Hazard or OB.
  *Above items have each unique ability: Power, Spin, Accuacy
- Energy drinks: Maximum 99 drinks each.
  *Drinks have following abilities: Power, Spin, Wind-removing, Putting Lie

Example)
Putting Lie
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/bbcaef5fa91eff1c37dabdfa6a5f7e1809d27dd0.png
Wind-Removing
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/cdcadeebeb004ffff81b9afd4c05b7d3bbce8286.png

- Spin
More Spin when you hit away from the center of a ball.


Known bugs:
(FIXED)- [strike]Please do not buy and use the golf ball from the Store if you are playing with a Xbox Pad (or any other Game pad). The Shot UI disappears.[/strike]

notes.title: Update Patchnote on 26th April
notes.content:
New & Updated Features:
- New Match Making
Online players will be shown on the right side of the lobby. Two AIs are located for instant match. Maximum of 5 users will be shown randomly.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/909d633dcf3beded9ab9ea229baac6651c6307fd.jpg

- Match Option
By turning off the match option, you will no longer get any match invitation.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/3e04d6f7621c2ee1d420155b92b3680918808fe8.jpg

- Right Hand
A right handed glove has been added. Arrows(effect) on the glove will be guiding how to use the Range Info UI.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/3df61a8881b3b7d8b0e268e6280e95844e6fb3a3.jpg

- Aim
Change the way to put the aim. Place the club head on the blue arrows to aim where you want. (This UI will not be shown at the ‘Pro’ difficulty)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/4c58162b3f32f6d762674c9e07e1ec0b1cd02b0b.jpg

- New Shot Info UI (Angle & Power)
After the ball perfectly landed on the ground, New Shot Info UI will be shown. It shows how much angle has the ball went from the aim, and the power of your last shot. (This UI will not be shown at the ‘Pro’ difficulty)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/e480ef66cdc5ebf44e0f912c4c36cfcc48d891bf.jpg

- New in game sound effects

Recently Updated Features:
- Distance UI
Many users wanted to know how far the ball went and what was their driving distance. Now from the moment when you hit the ball the distance UI will be appeared right above the ball until it lands on the ground.

notes.title: Fix update for the Oculus device
notes.content:
The bug - unable to play with the Oculus device - has now been fixed.

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Update Patchnote on 9th March
notes.content:
We are starting to implementing features that have been requested. We've been organizing the development schedule, and when the development starts to boost up the speed, we will be able to come to you with more contents. Thank you very much for all of your supports.

New & Updated Features:
- Distance UI
Many users wanted to know how far the ball went and what was their driving distance. Now from the moment when you hit the ball the distance UI will be appeared right above the ball until it lands on the ground.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/f2963bb2508d87f9640e65f5c6294335d1ee04a8.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/9212ce94a4204424066e7d9b5f842d3e6c7301f1.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/45f1ee38dc4f023d8973ae93bba0701952b34fb2.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27477616/b71e2e5effb457e8c6813372dc02862b57eb3e74.png
- Many bugs have been fixed

Recently Updated Features:
- Difficulty
There will be three difficulties that you may choose if you use Vive or Touch controllers. The default option is 'Amateur'.
   Amateur = Wind strength – Slow / Power&Angle assist – High 
   Semi-Pro = Wind strength – Normal / Power&Angle assist – Medium
   Pro = Wind strength – Normal / Power&Angle assist – No assist
          No Guide line / No auto club selection

- 1 on 1 Match
Players will be able to match and play against each other. All VR Golf Online players will be matched regardless of platform. The difficulty is set to be 'Semi-Pro' for the online match.

- Real-time Voice chat
Players are able to communicate by voice chat. However, if you do not want to chat through voice, there is an option to turn off.

- Support X-Box controller
The game officially support HTC Vive, Oculus Touch, Oculus Rift, and OSVR. For those who only has a HMD but no motion controller will be able to play the game in third person.

- Adjust ball position
The position of the ball was placed in the middle of a room. Now the player stands is centered so that no one has to worry about hitting the wall.

- 3D Character when playing AI mode

notes.title: Update on 22nd February
notes.content:
Thank you for your interest in our game. We aiming to be the number one Golf VR game. In order to do that, many updates are planned in this year. First update will be the cross-platfrom multiplay.

Since the former version of VR Golf Online was first released on Oculus store, with this update the actual game contents will be synced between platforms. So all players of the VR Golf Online will play against each other.
